title: Earth · NOAA ETOPO 2022
sampling: Bilinear sampling directly from the complete official 60-arc-second cell-centered ETOPO grid, with cyclic longitude. Raster pixel centers fall within latitude-center support; no polar extrapolation or 40k-point intermediate.
notes: EGM2008 vertical datum; includes Antarctic and Greenland ice surfaces. Elevation does not imply plate ownership or crust type. Separate Bird PB2002 boundaries may be shown.

overlays.reason: No crust or plate identity inferred from elevation.

boundary_source: Peter Bird PB2002: 5819 published great-circle boundary segments; no plate interior labels inferred.
